api: M1 cross-copy window/Surface rescue for multi-window route-A apps: when the runtime compat-shim's resolved copy of liboh_adapter_bridge.so's OHWindowManagerClient returns null for a sessionId (the process has two loaded bridge instances, each with its own sessions_ answering only through a single last-published-window slot, so a multi-window app's first-created/top Activity misses and gets an empty Surface = the 'alive-but-white'), the shim asks every OTHER loaded bridge copy (located via dl_iterate_phdr: same file = byte-identical code at the same executable offset) and returns the first non-null OHNativeWindow -> the top Activity gets its real Surface -> lit. Only the null-miss path changes; a non-null answer is returned as before.
